title: Snowflake is buying growth with gross margin
angle: AI workloads accelerated revenue 7 points and cost a point of product gross margin; headcount covered the difference.

frames.text: Snowflake's growth just accelerated to 37% and the stock jumped 17%.
Product revenue growth, up from 30% at the end of last year.
AI products were about half of that acceleration. CoCo is now in 9,100 accounts.
Full-year product gross margin guidance, cut from 75%. AI workloads carry lower contribution margins.
Operating margin guide went up anyway. 334 people added this year, against 935 last year.
AI revenue is real revenue, it just costs more to deliver. Hiring covered the difference.
